approval.note: Interpretation of a general instruction; the owner may withdraw it.
approval.record: owner instruction of 2026-10-03: 'make a full plan to implement everything left partial or not completely and implement'; work package WP-C of docs/134

decision_rule.discriminates_only_if: in BOTH development populations (Track A 2018 and Track B 2024) the strong-minus-weak difference is positive with the 95 percent interval excluding zero and the population meets the support gate
decision_rule.post_hoc_populations: 2019 and 2025 are reported descriptively and cannot change the decision
decision_rule.wording_if_met: a rule-based forecast-time heuristic whose STRONG class concentrates observed Ghats-coast heavy rain; not a validated or learned regime
decision_rule.wording_if_not_met: the heuristic does not discriminate on the development evidence and is shown without a claim

definition.classes: WEAK below the lower tercile of the training-year index, STRONG at or above the upper tercile, MODERATE between
definition.index: mean over the land cells of the Ghats-coast zone (coastal and orographic, docs/115) of the forecast cross-barrier forcing of docs/118 (850 hPa wind component along the local terrain gradient, positive upslope, times precipitable water)
definition.inputs: forecast U850, V850 and PWAT on the 0.5 degree context grid resampled to the 49 by 49 target grid, plus static terrain geometry; no observation and no model output
definition.percentile: rank of the index within the training-year distribution (not a probability)

evaluation.observed_quantity: per case, the number of heavy-rain cells (at least 64.5 mm per 24 h) among the valid IMD land cells of the zone, and their fraction
statistics: per class: cases, heavy event pairs, share of all heavy zone event pairs, mean heavy fraction, share of cases with a heavy cell
strong-minus-weak mean heavy fraction and the Spearman rank correlation of the index with the heavy fraction, each with a 95 percent whole-case bootstrap interval

forbidden: fitting a threshold on any validation or test year
changing the index, classes, rule or gate after any observation is compared
calling the heuristic a validated or learned regime
reading the percentile as a probability
pooling Track A and Track B

A2018.label: Track A 2018 validation year: development evidence

A2019.label: POST-HOC EXPLORATORY ANALYSIS OF THE COMPLETED 2019 FINAL TEST

B2024.label: Track B 2024 validation/selection year: development evidence

B2025.label: POST-HOC EXPLORATORY ANALYSIS OF THE COMPLETED 2025 FINAL TEST

purpose: Define a forecast-time coastal and orographic forcing regime and the test of whether it discriminates observed Ghats-coast heavy rain, BEFORE any observation is compared. A rule-based heuristic of the physical forcing, not a learned or validated regime and not a probability.
reproduction_gate: the observed heavy event pairs of every population must equal the Stage 1 zone evidence for the same cases exactly
class counts must equal the frozen forecast-only counts
the group event totals must equal an independent sum
